# Banc of California Names Darren Lemkau Regional President, Colorado


**Company Release - 10/29/2026**


## New leader has three decades of experience serving Colorado businesses.


**DENVER — October 29, 2026 —** Banc of California, a wholly owned subsidiary of Banc of California, Inc. (NYSE: BANC), announced today that Darren Lemkau has joined the bank as Regional President for the Colorado Region. Based in Denver, Lemkau will lead the bank’s commercial and community banking presence across Colorado, focusing on strengthening client relationships and advancing the bank’s long-term growth strategy.


“Colorado is important to us, and we have a lot of opportunity ahead,” said Jared Wolff, Chairman and CEO of Banc of California. “Business owners want a banking partner who knows them, understands their business and can deliver the right solutions as they grow. That’s what our team is focused on every day. Darren knows the local business community and shares our commitment to building lasting client relationships. We’re excited to welcome him to lead our team in Colorado.”


Lemkau brings more than 30 years of banking experience, including 13 years as President and CEO of Commerce Bank’s Colorado Region. His expertise spans middle market and corporate banking, commercial real estate, payments and credit underwriting.


“I’ve spent most of my career in Colorado and have seen firsthand the strength of its business community and the opportunities here,” Lemkau said. “I am proud to lead the Colorado Region for Banc of California, and I’m looking forward to serving the people and businesses that call the Colorado region home.”


Active in the community, Lemkau serves on the boards of Brent’s Place and the Colorado Business Roundtable.


With over $34 billion in assets,[Banc of California](https://bancofcal.com/) delivers a full suite of loan and deposit solutions that drive economic growth across Colorado. From the bank’s Denver office at 5050 S. Syracuse St., Lemkau and his Banc of California colleagues offer Commercial Real Estate Banking, Venture Banking, Asset-Based Lending, Small-Business Lending, Community Banking and Treasury Management. Banc of California is dedicated to the Denver and Colorado community and will continue to support the region’s growth and long-term success.


Banc of California is deeply committed to supporting affordable housing. The bank supports the Denver Housing Authority’s efforts to finance projects across the city, helping expand access to quality housing. In addition, Banc of California is dedicated to supporting the community, including organizations such as the African Leadership Group and Brent’s Place, among others.


A picture of Lemkau is available[here](https://dam.bancofcal.com/asset/c329ed88-a27c-4dc6-8439-d5ae28e61908/Lemkau-Darren.jpg) .


#### About Banc of California, Inc.


Banc of California, Inc. (NYSE: BANC) is a bank holding company with over $34 billion in assets and the parent company of Banc of California. Banc of California is one of the nation’s premier relationship-based business banks, providing banking and treasury management services to small, middle-market, and venture-backed businesses. Through its Private Banking division, the bank also serves individuals and families with personalized banking solutions, dedicated relationship management, and exceptional service. Banc of California is the largest publicly-traded bank headquartered in Los Angeles and the third largest bank headquartered in California and offers a broad range of loan and deposit products and services through 76 full-service branches located throughout California and in Denver, Colorado, and Durham, North Carolina, as well as through regional offices nationwide. The bank also provides full-service payment processing solutions to its clients and serves the Community Association Management industry nationwide with its technology-forward platform, SmartStreet™. The bank is committed to its local communities through the Banc of California Charitable Foundation, and by supporting organizations that provide financial literacy and job training, small business support, affordable housing, and more. Member FDIC. For more information, please visit us at[www.bancofcal.com](https://bancofcal.com/) .

## Banc of California, Inc. Reports Third Quarter Diluted Earnings per Share of $0.46, Up 21% Year Over Year


Banc of California, Inc. (NYSE: BANC) (“Banc of California” or the “Company”), the parent company of wholly-owned subsidiary Banc of California (the “Bank”), today reported financial results for the third quarter ended September 30, 2026. The Company reported net earnings available to common and equivalent stockholders of $73.1 million, or $0.46 per diluted common share, for the third quarter of 2026, compared to $59.7 million, or $0.38 per diluted common share for the third quarter of 2025. For the second quarter of 2026, the Company reported a net loss available to common and equivalent stockholders of $251.3 million, or $(1.61) per diluted common share, reflecting the previously announced strategic balance sheet repositioning.
